Zistgah · زیستگاه · habitat

A place to live and work
alongside machine intelligence.

Zistgah is a habitat, not a platform. It is an ecology of small, independent, inspectable things: a ground to stand on, ways of making, machinery for thinking, laboratories for real domains, and a written record. Take any one of them and use it on its own. Nothing here needs the rest, and nothing here needs you to sign up.

Why it exists

Most of what gets built for this moment asks you to move in: one account, one platform, one company's idea of how thinking should go. A habitat is the opposite. You should be able to take the part you need, run it on a laptop with the network unplugged, read exactly what it does, and rebuild it differently if you disagree.

So every component here is sovereign. It carries its own contract, states plainly what it does not do, and refuses to pretend. Where something is unknown it says “not established” rather than filling in a plausible number.

How to use it

Read. 47 components publish a page you can open in a browser with nothing installed.

Cite. 26 carry a DOI, so they can be referenced in work of your own.

Run. Clone any repository. Each one states what it needs and what it refuses to do.

Contribute. Work is broken into packages, each with a command that decides whether it is done. Take one.

Language, and every script
